recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-47393 unless OO later opens a separate issue to revisit the Task.note short display.
issue_request: FHIR-47393 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Task issue from OO. The reporter noted that Task.note's old definition, "Free-text information captured about the task as it progresses," could imply notes were limited to the in-progress portion of the task lifecycle. The approved resolution was to change the definition to "Free-text information about the task during its lifecycle."
initial_application: Commit ef79e2a519cfb356a05f218572862ac01b9207d1, merged by HL7/fhir#3208 as 5a1cb94cab08f5f2129a9d07395eb830bb388841, replaced the Task.note long definition in source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml with the Jira-approved lifecycle wording.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Task.note definition in source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml matches the Jira resolution. Task mapping exception sources and the checked-in SVG also contain the lifecycle wording. OO minutes from 2024-10-22 confirm a 4-0-0 Persuasive with Modification motion to reword the long definition and remove "as it progresses." Related searches did not find a later conflicting Task.note decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current FHIR core source already satisfies FHIR-47393. The obsolete "as it progresses" wording is absent from source/task, and changing the short display would exceed the narrow long-definition resolution.
